decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The Development hereby approved, shall be begun no later than the expiration of three years from the date of the original planning permission under reference 00505/366/P25 (dated 12/12/16).

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (see schedule above) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 3 - The development shall be completed in accordance with the details (Phasing) approved on the 09/05/2017 under application 00505/366/P25(3).

Condition : 4 - The development shall be completed in accordance with the details (Construction Management/Logistics Plans) approved on the 18/05/2017 under application 00505/366/P25(4A) and as approved on the 20/04/2018 under application 00505/366/P25(4B). All construction and demolition works shall be undertaken in accordance with the approved CMP and CLP.

Condition : 5 - No demolition or construction work shall take place on the site except between the hours of 8am to 5pm on Mondays to Friday and 8am to 1pm on Saturdays and not at all on Sundays and Public Holidays.
Condition : 6 - The development shall be completed in accordance with the details (Construction Travel Plan) approved on the 17/04/2018 under application 00505/366/P25(6).

Condition : 7 - (A). Development shall not commence (except demolition, archaeological investigations, ground condition investigations and intrusive site surveys and other enabling works: site clearance; soil storage; remedial works in respect of any contamination or any other adverse ground conditions; erection of any temporary means of enclosure and land raising) until a scheme for the storage and collection of waste and materials to be recycled for each residential unit has been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority.
(B). No part of the residential development shall be occupied until the waste and recycling facilities approved under Part (A) of this condition have been provided and made available for use by residents to which those facilities relate. Such facilities shall remain throughout the lifetime of the development and shall be used for no other purposes.
Condition : 9 - 90% of residential units shall meet M4(2) Building Regulations as shown on the hereby approved plans.
Condition : 10 - A minimum 10% 'Wheelchair User Dwellings' built to Building Regulations M4(3) standard shall be provided.

Condition : 11 - (A). The development shall be completed in accordance with the details (Noise Assessment) approved on the 21/11/2017 under application 00505/366/P25(11) and approved on the 30/10/2017 under application 00505/366/P25(11Ai). Any works that form part of such a scheme shall be completed as approved before any part of the development within the relevant phase is first occupied.
(B). Prior to the development being occupied, measurement reports in accordance with the Associate of Noise Consultants guidelines - Noise Measurements in buildings (ANC-9801) Part 2: Noise from external sources (e.g. traffic noise) demonstrating compliance with the scheme approved under Part A of this condition shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 12 - The development shall be completed in accordance with the details (Drainage) approved on the 30/10/2017 under application 00505/366/P25(12i).

Condition : 13 - Prior to occupation of the relevant phase of the development, the applicant must submit for review and approval by the Lead Local Flood Authority evidence that the drainage system has been built as per the final detailed drainage designs through the submission of photographs and copies of installation contracts, and written confirmation that the drainage features will be managed as per the detailed maintenance plan for the lifetime of the development.

Condition : 14 - Before development (except demolition, archaeological investigations, ground condition investigations and intrusive site surveys and other enabling works: site clearance; soil storage; remedial works in respect of any contamination or any other adverse ground conditions; erection of any temporary means of enclosure and land raising) commences:
a.	The development shall be completed in accordance with the details approved on the 18/12/2017 under application 00505/366/P25(14Ai).
b.	If required, a scheme for decontamination of the site shall be submitted to the Local Planning Authority, for written approval.  The scheme shall account for any comments made by the Local Planning Authority before the development hereby permitted is first occupied.
   During the course of the development:
c.	The Local Planning Authority shall be notified immediately if additional contamination is discovered during the course of the development. A competent person shall assess the additional contamination, and shall submit appropriate amendments to the scheme for decontamination in writing to the Local Planning Authority for approval before any work on that aspect of development continues.  
   Before the development is first brought into use:
d.	The agreed scheme for decontamination referred to in clauses b) and c) above, including amendments, shall be fully implemented and a written validation (closure) report submitted to the Local Planning Authority for approval.

Condition : 15 - (A) The development shall be completed in accordance with the details (Energy Strategy) approved on the 15/06/2017 under application 00505/366/P25(15A).
(B) Prior to first occupation of the relevant Phase of the development, evidence (e.g. photographs, installation contracts and As-Built certificates under the National Calculation Method should be submitted to the Local Planning Authority and approved in writing to show that the development has been constructed in accordance with the approved Energy Strategy, and any subsequent approved revisions.

Condition : 16 - Prior to first occupation of the residential Phase of the development, evidence (schedule of fittings and manufactures literature) shall be submitted to the Local Planning Authority and approved in writing to demonstrate that the development has been constructed so that internal water consumption in each dwelling will not exceed 105 litres/person/day in line with The Water Efficiency Calculator for new dwellings from the Department of Communities and Local Government.

Condition : 17 - Prior to first occupation of the residential Phase of the development, evidence shall be submitted to the Local Planning Authority and approved in writing to show that the residential development has been constructed with materials that have secured the following sustainability standards:
(A) At least three of the key elements of the building envelope (external walls, windows roof, upper floor slabs, internal walls, floor finishes/coverings) achieve a rating of A+ to D in the Building Research Establishment's (BRE) 'The Green Guide of Specification'.
(B) At least 50% of timber and timber products are sourced from accredited Forest Stewardship Council (FSC) or Programme for the Endorsement of Forestry Certification (PEFC) schemes.
(C) No construction or insulation materials are used which will release toxins into the internal and external environment, including those that deplete stratospheric ozone.

Condition : 18 - Within three months of work starting on site a BREEAM Design Stage certificate and summary score sheet (or such equivalent standard that replaces this) must be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority to show that an 'Excellent' (minimum score 70%) rating will be achieved.

Condition : 19 - Within 6 months of first occupation of the hotel development a BREEAM Post-Construction Review certificate and summary score sheet (or such equivalent standard that replaces this) must be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority to show that an 'Excellent' (minimum score 70%) rating has been achieved.

Condition : 21 - Prior to occupation of the residential phase of the development, a Car Park Management Plan shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The Plan shall include, as a minimum:
- details of electric vehicle charging points with a provision of 20% 'active' and 20% 'passive' across the development;
- details of the monitoring arrangements to ensure 'passive' electric vehicle charging points are brought into use when required; and 
- details of the measures to restrict unauthorised parking across the site.
The Plan shall be implemented as approved for the lifetime of the development.

Condition : 22 - Prior to occupation of the hotel, a Car Park Management Plan shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The Plan shall include, as a minimum:
- a strategy for managing coach parking
- details of the provision of on-site parking for disabled members of staff (including associated signage/markings)
- details of on-site parking for other members of staff (including associated signage/markings)
- details of how hotel guests will be restricted from parking on surrounding streets
- details of how hotel guests will only be permitted to park on-site whilst they are physically staying at the hotel.
The Plan shall be implemented as approved for the lifetime of the development.

Condition : 23 - Prior to commencement of the relevant phase (except demolition, archaeological investigations, ground condition investigations and intrusive site surveys and other enabling works: site clearance; soil storage; remedial works in respect of any contamination or any other adverse ground conditions; erection of any temporary means of enclosure and land raising), details of cycle storage for the relevant Phase of the development shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. Cycle parking should be provided to achieve the minimum London Plan standards and in accordance with the advice contained within the Local Plan. The cycle parking shall be provided in accordance with the approved details before the relevant Phase of development is first occupied and shall thereafter be retained solely for its designated use.

Condition : 24 - The development shall be completed in accordance with the details (Highway Works) approved on the 22/11/2017 under application 00505/366/P25(24). Such works shall be completed prior to the first occupation of the relevant Phase of development.

Condition : 25 - Pedestrian visibility splays shall be provided at the new vehicular access to Upper Sutton Lane, with nothing over 500mm in these locations, prior to the first occupation of the hotel.

Condition : 26 - Prior to the first occupation of any part of the development, the parking, loading and turning spaces relevant to that Phase, as set out in the approved plans, shall be constructed and made available for use. This shall include the provision of to coach parking bays for use by the hotel, as indicated on Attachment 7 of the Transport Addendum. The parking, loading and turning spaces shall then be retained as such and shall not be used for any other purposes thereafter. No loading or unloading shall occur on the public highway.

Condition : 27 - Prior to the first occupation of the hotel, a Servicing Management Plan shall be submitted and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority demonstrating how the hotel development will manage deliveries and servicing to minimise conflict with other road users and the hotel car park.

Condition : 28 - No commercial deliveries shall be taken at or dispatched from the site outside the hours of 09.00 hours to 17.30 hours Monday to Saturday nor outside the hours of 09.00 hours to 14.00 hours on Sundays, Bank or Public Holidays.

Condition : 29 - The development shall be completed in accordance with the details (Inclusive Access Strategy) approved on the 22/11/2017 under application 00505/366/P25(29). The approved strategy shall be implemented throughout the lifetime of the development.

Condition : 30 - Any fixed external plant shall be designed and installed to ensure that noise emanating from such plant is at least 10dB below the background noise levels when measured from the nearest sensitive receptors. Plant shall be set in from the roof boundaries by a minimum of 2m (unless shown otherwise on the approved plans). No further fans, louvres, ducts or other external plant shall be installed without the written prior approval of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 31 - Prior to installation, details of any external ventilation equipment for any Phase, including ducting and any necessary noise attenuation measures, shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The works shall then be carried out in accordance with the approved details before that Phase is first occupied.

Condition : 32 - Notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) Order 2015 (or any order revoking and re-enacting that Order with or without modification), no fences, gates or walls shall be erected within the curtilage of any dwellinghouse forward of any wall of that dwellinghouse which fronts onto a road.

Condition : 33 - Notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) Order 2015 (or any order revoking and re-enacting that Order with or without modification), no windows/dormer windows other than those expressly authorised by this permission shall be constructed or installed.

Condition : 34 - Notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development Order) Order 2015 (or any order revoking and re-enacting that Order with or without modification), no enlargement of the premises or any additional structures/buildings other than those expressly authorised by this permission shall be shall be carried out.

Condition : 35 - Prior to completion of the frame of the hotel, a Bird Hazard Management Plan shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The submitted plan shall include details of:
- Management of any flat/shallow pitched/green roofs on buildings within the site which may be attractive to nesting, roosting and "loafing" birds. The management plan shall comply with Advice Note 8 'Potential Bird Hazards from Building Design'.
The Bird Hazard Management Plan shall be implemented as approved, on completion of the development and shall remain in force for the life of the building.
Condition : 36 - No amplified or other music played in or from the hotel shall be audible within the nearest residential unit.

Condition : 37 - Prior to the occupation of the hotel, a scheme for the control of noise, fumes and odours for that unit, including details of sound attenuation for any necessary plant and a detailed assessment of the effectiveness of the scheme, shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The scheme shall then be implemented as approved and shall be retained and maintained in good working order as such thereafter.
description: Variation of Condition 2 to increase the number of hotel bedrooms from 118 to 125, to remove the ground floor undercroft area to the hotel and replace it with internal front of house accommodation with activated frontage and to increase the cycle storage within the apartment blocks following planning permission 00505/366/P25 dated 12/12/2016 for "Demolition of the existing hotel buildings and the construction of a new four-storey, 118 bed hotel with associated facilities, access and parking and 34 new dwellings comprising 18 three-bedroom houses, four two-bedroom accessible houses and 12  two-bedroom flats, with associated amenity space, access and parking".
